title: Reading and translation into English flash cards

cards.front: Translate: actuellement.
Translate: une librairie.
Translate: ne...que.
Translate: malgré.
Translate: sauf.
Translate: trop cher.
Translate: rapidement.
Translate: la semaine dernière.
Translate: à l'avenir.
Translate: je voudrais.
Read: Ma sœur adore la musique, mais mon frère préfère lire. Give each person's preference.
Read: Avant, je détestais le sport. Maintenant, je joue au tennis tous les jours. Give the earlier opinion and present activity.
Read: Le village est calme, mais il manque des magasins. Give an advantage and a disadvantage.
back: There is a lack of shops.

cards.front: Read: Les billets ne sont pas chers, mais le voyage est long. Give the positive and negative.
Translate: Je viens de finir mes devoirs.
back: I have just finished my homework.

cards.front: Translate: J'habite ici depuis deux ans.
back: I have lived here for two years.

cards.front: Translate: Je ne regarde plus la télévision.
Explain what les refers to in Les livres sont chers, mais je les achète.
back: The books. Les is a direct object pronoun replacing les livres.

cards.front: Infer the meaning of impossible in Cette solution est impossible, and identify the word-family clue.
back: Impossible; im- gives the opposite of possible.

cards.front: Infer consommateur from consommer and a shopping context.
back: A consumer. The agent ending refers to a person who consumes/buys products.

cards.front: Translate: Hier, nous avons pris le bus parce que les billets étaient moins chers.
back: Yesterday, we took the bus because the tickets were cheaper.
Keep the past event, reason and comparison.

cards.front: Translate: Je voudrais travailler dans une librairie, mais ma sœur préfère la bibliothèque.
back: I would like to work in a bookshop, but my sister prefers the library.
Do not confuse librairie and bibliothèque.

cards.front: Translate: Il n'y a pas assez de bus, donc je vais à pied au collège.
back: There are not enough buses, so I walk to school.
Not enough does not mean no buses.

cards.front: Translate: Les amis que je retrouve au parc sont très gentils.
back: The friends whom/that I meet in the park are very kind.
Que introduces the people met; très modifies kind.

cards.front: Translate: L'année dernière, j'ai passé une semaine en France. La ville était belle, mais il pleuvait souvent. À l'avenir, je vais voyager en train.
back: Last year, I spent a week in France. The town/city was beautiful, but it often rained / was often raining. In future, I am going to travel by train.
Preserve the completed visit, background weather, frequency and future plan.

cards.front: Explain four checks to make after translating a passage into English.
back: Subjects and pronoun references are correct.
Time frames and negatives are preserved.
Numbers, comparisons and qualifiers retain their precise meanings.
